#### Our alumni are working at 200+ top companies
Siddharth Maheshwari is a tech entrepreneur who co-founded Newton School, an online learning platform launched in 2019 that focuses on making students industry-ready. ‍ His entrepreneurial journey began with Flicksup, a social network for content discovery. Later, he collaborated with Nishant Chandra to create Bolo, a video-based Q&A platform for educational content. After observing the significant skill gap between Indian students and industry requirements, both co-founders established Newton School to address this challenge.
Nishant Chandra is an accomplished entrepreneur. His passion for education led him to Unacademy in 2017, where he served as Category Head and Product Manager, gaining deep insights into the ed-tech space. ‍ In 2019, he partnered with his IIT Roorkee batchmate Siddharth Maheshwari to launch Bolo, a video-based Q&A platform connecting users with industry experts. AI agents aren't coming. They're already here. Every industry, every role, every workflow — being rewritten right now

## Decoded: What is Agentic AI
Agentic AI is advanced AI that plans and acts by itself to reach goals with little human help.
By Dario Amodei (CEO of Anthropic )
You deserve the truth about AI You've probably heard a few things about AI. Most of them aren't true.
I need to know how to code to use AI agents.
Modern agent tools are built for non-engineers. If you can write a brief or fill a form, you can build an agent.
AI agents are only for big tech companies.
A sales associate at a startup and a team lead at an MNC are both already using agents to cut hours of repetitive work.
This will replace my job.
People who know how to direct agents will replace people who don't. This course puts you on the right side of that line.
### Industry - Grade AI Tool Kit
## Your Role Reimagined with Agentic AI
Every role has a smarter version find your's below. Pick your domain and see exactly what Agentic AI can own for you
### Design Stunning AI Visuals
Generate professional images and videos in minutes, not days
### Build AI Tools, Zero Code
Launch your own GPTs and AI apps
### Automate Repetitive Work

### Write Prompts That Deliver
Get expert-level results every time
## Industry Ready Curriculum
4-month curriculum. Hands-on projects. Industry-proven mentors.
LEVEL 1
### AI Fundamentals with Prompt Engineering
Curriculum:
- Introduction to Prompt Engineering & AI Fundamentals
- Build your personal AI tool stack – tool research, account setup and create a model routing worksheet
- Advanced Prompting: Chain-of-Thought, Meta Prompting, and Persona Design
- Skills, GEMs, and Custom AI Tools – turn recurring tasks into reusable workflows
- Setting up a Local AI Workspace with MSTY and open-source models
- Claude as your AI Workspace – configure Projects, Cowork, memory, and persistent context for professional work
LEVEL 2
### Workflow Automations with Agentic AI
- Indentify trigger-action-condition-handoff points and design an automation-ready Agentic workflow
- Build workflows with n8n / Make – AI nodes, multi-agent roles, and cost-aware model routing
- Learn API Integrations without code
- Tokenisation, Vector Databases, and Knowledge Bases – load documents into Supabase or NotebookLM and test retrieval
- Running, Testing, and Monitoring automations
- Explore the Ecosystem: OpenRouter, Crew.ai, and Cost Optimisation – benchmark models and design per-task routing rules
LEVEL 3
### Building Production Grade Agents
- Knowledge & Research Agent – pipeline using Perplexity, Claude & Supabase / NotebookLM
- Build an end-to-end Job Application Agent
- Information Retrieval with Memory and RAG-based Systems – multi-source pipelines into clear insights and presentations
- Multimodal Generation: Image, Video, and Voiceovers
- Distribution Automation – prepare metadata, schedule content, and push to social media automatically.
- Agent-Triggered Workflows: OpenClaw & Claude Dispatch – fire automations remotely from Telegram or a phone command
LEVEL 4
### Productisation & Launch
- From Automation to Product – define MVP scope, backend tables, data flow, and connect an AI-native app builder
- Build-along App 1: The Career Agent App – deploy a live career app with a public portfolio layer and job-search engine
- Build-along App 2: BYOB – build and deploy a media app that turns a topic input into research, generated assets, and optional publishing
- Launch Strategy and Go-to-Market – Product Hunt listing, launch copy, pricing, and ICP definition
- AI Portfolio and Personal Brand Finalisation – case studies, LinkedIn profile update, and concise AI capability pitch
